notes.title: Minor update - 1.0.7888.23068
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I've just uploaded a minor update. Ed-dee, Bumpy, TAI-CHO, ITRO-bex and boo enemies got some minimal animations. I think this little change made the game more living.

notes.title: PATCH 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
I'm releasing the first big patch of Carebotz. I updated and fixed many features of the game by player feedbacks and reports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39142995/e0a168de4414b9875ebb3bce8eab0ed30e81edba.png[/img]

[b]BIBZ[/b]
	[list]
[*] slightly increase the model size to get it more visible
[*] 	add facing indicator
[*] 	balance weapons
[*] 	slightly increase moving speed
[*] 	fix "retalent" - now you can unbuild your upgrades and get back all of your spent resources
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] O-XO - slightly increased damage
[*] Bumbpy - drop more mines
[*] ED-DEE - faster rotation
[*] Xumm-O-TRON - increased hull
[*] ITRO-BEX - moe effective repair
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39142995/c7a7cedaf04afa35ad862b0335e03f6f16f68a37.png[/img]
	
[b]Resources[/b]
	[list]
[*] increase the juice crystals count on the map
[*] 	decrease some upgrades prices
[/list]
	
[b]Camera[/b]
	[list]
[*] fix some camera shake problem
[*] 	move closer to the main caracter
[*] 	fix some postprocessing glitch effects
[/list]
	
[b]Map[/b]
	[list]
[*] last opened gate now pulsing on the map
[*] 	detailed map graphics - now you can see the map borders
[*] 	change icon size
[*] 	open/closed gate icon color fix
[/list]
	
[b]Story[/b]
	[list]
[*] updated story texts
[/list]
	
[b]Progression[/b]
	[list]
[*] show the right progression value
[/list]
